minBetUsd.title: Minimum bet (USD)
minBetUsd.description: Only bets at least this large. Fills of one order placed within 5 minutes are added together first.

onlySmartMoney.title: Only smart money
onlySmartMoney.description: Only bets from wallets ranked inside the cut-off below on Polymarket's profit leaderboard.

smartMoneyTopRank.title: Smart money cut-off (leaderboard rank)
smartMoneyTopRank.description: A bettor counts as smart money when ranked this high or better by profit, all time or over the last 30 days, with positive profit.

marketKeywords.title: Market keywords
marketKeywords.description: Only markets whose title matches one of these, e.g. election, bitcoin, fed, nba.

sides.title: Sides
sides.description: BUY, SELL, or empty for both.

wallets.title: Follow wallets
wallets.description: Only bets from these wallet addresses (0x...), for following specific traders.

skipNearCertain.title: Skip near-certain trades
skipNearCertain.description: Skip trades priced at 97 cents or above, or 3 cents or below: parking cash in, or cashing out of, an outcome already decided.

onlyNew.title: Only bets since the last run
onlyNew.description: On: each run picks up where the previous one ended, for alerts on a schedule. Off: every bet in the lookback window.

lookbackMinutes.title: Lookback (minutes)
lookbackMinutes.description: How far back the first run (or every run, with only-new off) reaches.

maxBets.title: Max bets
maxBets.description: Stop after this many bets, largest first.
